title: I found this: LEAF Hydro Tower – Vertical Hydroponic Growing System
prompt:
A vertical 9:16 UGC-style testimonial ad filmed on a phone for a local shop in Rwanda. Setting: the aisle of a busy Kigali shop. Light: natural shop light. Music: light, happy beat under the voice.
The LEAF Hydro Tower – Vertical Hydroponic Growing System must look exactly as in Image 1: same shape, colours, logo and label.
0-2s: Handheld selfie-style shot at arm's length, natural handheld phone camera with a slight shake: a friendly fictional Rwandan woman in her twenties in a bright everyday top walks into the shop holding the phone camera, excited. The presenter says to the camera in English: "Look what I found at LEAF Business GROUP LTD!"
2-6s: Close-up, natural handheld phone camera with a slight shake: the presenter picks the LEAF Hydro Tower from Image 1 up from the shelf and shows it to the camera.
6-8s: Medium shot, waist up, natural handheld phone camera with a slight shake: the presenter tries the LEAF Hydro Tower, nods and smiles.
8-10s: Clean hero shot, subject centred, locked-off static camera: the LEAF Hydro Tower held close to the lens, the presenter smiling behind it, slightly blurred. The presenter says to the camera in English: "LEAF Hydro Tower offers a space-saving way to grow fresh vegetables."
Clean frames with no on-screen text, captions or added logos.
notes: The presenter is a fictional person described in words, so the face changes between clips. Pick a digital character from the library for the same face every time.
The price has conditions, so it is not spoken; show it in the caption instead.
